title: Khudara haye khudara
body:
Khudara haye khudara
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye
Haye Sughra (sa) .....2
Yeh Khat Mein Baba Ko Sughra (sa) Ne Likha Haale Tapa-
Tumhare Baad Huwe Teen Eidi Baba Jaan-
Shabe Baarat Huwi Dusre Mahine Aaiya-
Baruye Hamza Nathi Mujh Mein Fateha Ki Tavaa-
Arey Tamam Roz Tadapte Tadapte Raat Huwi-
<<MINI>>
Hamare Ghar Mein Na Eid-e-shabe Baarat Huwi-
Hamare Ghar Mein Na Eid-e-shabe Baarat Huwi....
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh Roz To Gaya Din Eid-e-fitr Ka Aaya-
Ghaar Aan Kar Meri Humjoliyo Ne Rulwaya-
Kisi Ne Gehna Kisi Ne Libas Dikhlaya-
Koi Yeh Buli Ke Eide Mein Humne Yeh Paaya-
Har Ek Kush Tha Magar Mere Lab Pe Naale The-
<<MINI>>
Safar Mein Sab Meri Eidi Ke Dene Waale The-
Safar Mein Sab Meri Eidi Ke Dene Waale The....
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh Kush Ho Eid Mein Kya Jo Kalap Ka Maara Ho-
Arey Qasam Lo Baba Jo Qurta Pbata Utaara Ho-
Watan Mein Laut Ke Aana Jo Phir Tumhara Ho- To Phir Se Eid Ho Nauroz Bhi Dubara Ho-
Arey Hamari Eid To Qunbe Ke Deed Hai Baba-
Jab Aap Aaye Usi Roz Eid Hai Baba-
